title: FlowRunsPanel: the region grouping key reads `branch` for parallel-branch steps — `ExecutionStepLog.iteration` is single-valued in the next `@objectstack/spec` release (objectstack#14414, ruling A)
body:
Filed by the objectstack `domain:spec` execution seat (session `session_01H2oQebDDxYKfWZusyd8GXk`, objectstack seat post #6017) at the ACCEPT of objectstack PR #15227 (objectstack#14414, contract review objectstack comment 5536760564, 2026-09-04T06:43Z). Unassigned; `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's — the repair lands in `packages/app-shell` (a published library), so the three-stream rule reads it as the objectui execution seat's.

Restart-when: an `@objectstack/spec` release above 17.2.0 whose `ExecutionStepLogSchema` (`@objectstack/spec/automation`) declares an optional `branch` member is installable from npm and pinned by this repo (probe: `node -e "const s=require('@objectstack/spec/automation');process.exit('branch' in s.ExecutionStepLogSchema.shape?0:1)"` exits 0 on the installed package)
Restart-touch: packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/FlowRunsPanel.tsx

## The contract change this follows

Maintainer ruling on objectstack#14414 (2026-09-03, recorded as objectstack comment 5519397028), option A: `ExecutionStepLog.iteration` is single-valued — the zero-based iteration of the enclosing `loop`, carried through any nesting — and the parallel branch index moves to a new optional `branch` key, present only on a step inside a `parallel` branch. objectstack PR #15227 lands the spec half; the engine tagger that writes `branch` is a follow-on objectstack card.

The director seat measured the consumers of a step record's `iteration` before the ruling: exactly one — this panel's grouping key, `${regionKind}#${iteration}` (`FlowRunsPanel.tsx`, the region grouping), plus its local step type whose comment still reads "Zero-based loop iteration or parallel branch index of the enclosing region" (`:44-45` on objectui `origin/main` `24e027e9` at 2026-09-04T06:43Z).

## What to build (once the release is installable)

- The grouping key for `regionKind: 'parallel-branch'` steps uses `branch` (the branch index) and, when present, `iteration` (the enclosing loop's row) — so a branch step of a parallel node inside a loop body groups under its row AND its branch instead of under a number that used to be the branch index.
- The local step type gains `branch?: number` and the single-meaning comment; `loop-body` / `try` / `catch` grouping on `iteration` is unchanged.
- A record written by an engine that predates the objectstack tagger follow-on carries no `branch` and its `iteration` under `parallel-branch` still holds the legacy branch index — the panel's rule for that case (the acceptance criteria of objectstack's ADR-0087 entry `execution-step-iteration-single-valued`: treat it as the legacy branch index only when the record predates the engine build that writes `branch`) is the dev's to implement or to state as not distinguishable from the record alone.

Why `pm:on-hold` rather than `pm:queue`: this repo consumes `@objectstack/spec` as a published package (17.2.0 today), so "the upstream PR merged" is not the unlock — installability is; the `Restart-when:` line above is the executable criterion, and objectui#7597 / objectui#7588 carry the same gate for the same reason.

Refs: objectstack#14414 · objectstack PR #15227 · objectstack#14324 (spec release gate) · #1505 (the grouping this panel introduced)
